lastPass.notes: Reviewed BackupController and BackupResource against BackupService and BackupControllerTest. Deduped open issues #926 (CreateBackup hardcodes Id=1), #928 (unstable list-index ids). Filed #1001: POST /backup/restore accepts any Backups/*.zip while GET lists only seedarr_backup_*.zip and DELETE fileName requires list membership, leaving orphan zips restorable but not deletable via API. RBAC (Reader list vs Admin mutate/download), path traversal checks, and restore exception mapping align with tests. No dotnet build/test.
